name: Rising Steam
body:
The range of your breath of steam power increases to a 10-foot radius.

Prerequisite: Relluk, character level 6.

Benefit: The range of your breath of steam racial trait becomes 10 feet instead of 5 feet.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
